programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: "NONE OF YOUR BUSINESS" is a documentary film about the life and death of Ebrahim Monsefi, commonly known as Ebram; a popular southern guitar player, singer and poet in Iran who was born 70 years ago in Bandar-Abbas and passed away 50 years afterwards. He suffered such a sad end that it made it almost impossible for anyone to tell if he committed suicide or died a natural death. Although he passed away almost two decades ago, thoughts and debates still continue about the cause and reason for his death. Ebrahim spent his whole life writing lyrics and composing music in solitude and recorded them in solitude as well, he never recorded in a studio. Since his death, his works have been discovered and published little by little, and over time more and more people have referred to his music and several musicians have started covering them. Many have become interested in his life. He has reached fame posthumously (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: The movie is about a drama that unfolds because of a clause in the penal code. Naciye is raped by a group of men. Since Naciye is a prostitute, the defendants are tried under Article 438. This article in the penal code gives a reduced sentence to those who rape prostitutes. Therefore, the defendants are acquitted. Naciye's experience resonates with the public. Campaigns are launched for the repeal of the article. However, Naciye was forgotten in this process. She was first fired from her job when news about her having a passport appeared in the press. Then her children are given to an orphanage by the state. Meanwhile, journalist Oktay interviews Naciye to learn the truth. Naciye will have the opportunity to make people hear her voice. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: American sitcom about a well-off bachelor whose life is disrupted when his brother and young nephew move in with him. Alan finds out that Charlie stole his girlfriend in high school and sets out to get revenge by stealing his brother's French girlfriend Gabrielle, but things don't work out due to Gabrielle's behaviour in bed - meanwhile, Jake gets dumped by his girlfriend and seeks advice from Charlie to patch things up. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Kindness is Contatious profiles bleeding-edge scientists and authors from UC Berkeley, Harvard and everywhere in between as well as real life people whose lives illustrate their incredible discovery: THAT KINDNESS IS CONTAGIOUS. Street performers, soup kitchen volunteers, police officers, models, CEOs, baseball players, roller girls, concert pianists, artists, and many more tell you their heartfelt stories of kindness and generosity. The shocking revelation is that nice guys do indeed finish first. Learn how a little generosity can help you live a happier, healthier, wealthier, longer and more fulfilling life. Written by Anonymous (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Nestled in picturesque central New Jersey, Princeton seems almost too good to be true. Home to one of the world's great universities, the town is, to the casual observer, a progressive community of unparalleled beauty and grace. Yet upon closer inspection, Princeton can also be seen as a town divided, racially, economically and sociologically. The most obvious - and powerful - of all is the division between the university and the town itself, and nowhere was this division more keenly felt than during the tumultuous period of the late sixties through the early seventies. I Grew Up In Princeton is a heartfelt, deeply personal look at this unique confluence of time and place (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: "NONE OF YOUR BUSINESS" is a documentary film about the life and death of Ebrahim Monsefi, commonly known as Ebram; a popular southern guitar player, singer and poet in Iran who was born 70 years ago in Bandar-Abbas and passed away 50 years afterwards. He suffered such a sad end that it made it almost impossible for anyone to tell if he committed suicide or died a natural death. Although he passed away almost two decades ago, thoughts and debates still continue about the cause and reason for his death. Ebrahim spent his whole life writing lyrics and composing music in solitude and recorded them in solitude as well, he never recorded in a studio. Since his death, his works have been discovered and published little by little, and over time more and more people have referred to his music and several musicians have started covering them. Many have become interested in his life. He has reached fame posthumously (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: The movie is about a drama that unfolds because of a clause in the penal code. Naciye is raped by a group of men. Since Naciye is a prostitute, the defendants are tried under Article 438. This article in the penal code gives a reduced sentence to those who rape prostitutes. Therefore, the defendants are acquitted. Naciye's experience resonates with the public. Campaigns are launched for the repeal of the article. However, Naciye was forgotten in this process. She was first fired from her job when news about her having a passport appeared in the press. Then her children are given to an orphanage by the state. Meanwhile, journalist Oktay interviews Naciye to learn the truth. Naciye will have the opportunity to make people hear her voice. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: American sitcom about a well-off bachelor whose life is disrupted when his brother and young nephew move in with him. Alan finds out that Charlie stole his girlfriend in high school and sets out to get revenge by stealing his brother's French girlfriend Gabrielle, but things don't work out due to Gabrielle's behaviour in bed - meanwhile, Jake gets dumped by his girlfriend and seeks advice from Charlie to patch things up. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Michael Bluth, a widower, wants nothing more than to be a good father to his 13-year-old son George Michael, so he resolves to quit the family business for good and move to Arizona to start a new life. But instead Michael's eccentric family pulls him back in when his father, George Bluth Sr., gets arrested for shift accounting practices at Bluth Co. This sends the family reeling, and when their assets are frozen, this puts a major crimp in each of their lives. Michael reluctantly finds himself having to pull his offbeat family up by their bootstraps and slowly teach them how to live without the family's largess. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Kindness is Contatious profiles bleeding-edge scientists and authors from UC Berkeley, Harvard and everywhere in between as well as real life people whose lives illustrate their incredible discovery: THAT KINDNESS IS CONTAGIOUS. Street performers, soup kitchen volunteers, police officers, models, CEOs, baseball players, roller girls, concert pianists, artists, and many more tell you their heartfelt stories of kindness and generosity. The shocking revelation is that nice guys do indeed finish first. Learn how a little generosity can help you live a happier, healthier, wealthier, longer and more fulfilling life. Written by Anonymous (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Nestled in picturesque central New Jersey, Princeton seems almost too good to be true. Home to one of the world's great universities, the town is, to the casual observer, a progressive community of unparalleled beauty and grace. Yet upon closer inspection, Princeton can also be seen as a town divided, racially, economically and sociologically. The most obvious - and powerful - of all is the division between the university and the town itself, and nowhere was this division more keenly felt than during the tumultuous period of the late sixties through the early seventies. I Grew Up In Princeton is a heartfelt, deeply personal look at this unique confluence of time and place (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: American sitcom about a well-off bachelor whose life is disrupted when his brother and young nephew move in with him. When Alan is through with disastrous "romantic" dates and gets Charlie to find him a cheap yet classy hooker, his lack of sexual self-confidence somehow wrecks even a professional's routine - meanwhile, Jake can only get a date with a girl by agreeing to double-date with her mother, her ex, and a reluctant Charlie who can't even remember the mother's name. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Mick.
programme.desc: Mackenzie "Mickey" Murphy, a hard-living, rude and foul-mouthed woman takes a role of a lifetime when she is left to take care of her wealthy sister's three spoiled children - 18-year-old Sabrina,13-year-old Chip and 7-year-old Ben, when her sister flees the country with her husband to avoid criminal charges. programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Michael Bluth, a widower, wants nothing more than to be a good father to his 13-year-old son George Michael, so he resolves to quit the family business for good and move to Arizona to start a new life. But instead Michael's eccentric family pulls him back in when his father, George Bluth Sr., gets arrested for shift accounting practices at Bluth Co. This sends the family reeling, and when their assets are frozen, this puts a major crimp in each of their lives. Michael reluctantly finds himself having to pull his offbeat family up by their bootstraps and slowly teach them how to live without the family's largess. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Mom.
programme.desc: Single mom Christy has her hands full with two children, Violet and Roscoe, and maintaining newfound sobriety, when her passive-aggressive, recovering-alcoholic mother re-enters the picture, brimming with criticisms about Christy's life. As the daughter works to be the best mother she can and to overcome mistakes she made, she must also navigate dysfunctional relationships with romantic interests, and with her irresponsible ex-husband, Baxter. programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: The Towering Inferno star Susan Blakely makes a guest appearance in this episode of the American sitcom about a well-off bachelor whose life is disrupted when his brother and young nephew move in with him. Charlie dates a self-help author who is much older than him, has a 32-year-old son, and treats him more like her son than his boyfriend - meanwhile, Jake tries to write a book report over a weekend but keeps losing the book before he can read it. (Two and a Half Men). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Michael Bluth, a widower, wants nothing more than to be a good father to his 13-year-old son George Michael, so he resolves to quit the family business for good and move to Arizona to start a new life. But instead Michael's eccentric family pulls him back in when his father, George Bluth Sr., gets arrested for shift accounting practices at Bluth Co. This sends the family reeling, and when their assets are frozen, this puts a major crimp in each of their lives. Michael reluctantly finds himself having to pull his offbeat family up by their bootstraps and slowly teach them how to live without the family's largess. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.

programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Michael Bluth, a widower, wants nothing more than to be a good father to his 13-year-old son George Michael, so he resolves to quit the family business for good and move to Arizona to start a new life. But instead Michael's eccentric family pulls him back in when his father, George Bluth Sr., gets arrested for shift accounting practices at Bluth Co. This sends the family reeling, and when their assets are frozen, this puts a major crimp in each of their lives. Michael reluctantly finds himself having to pull his offbeat family up by their bootstraps and slowly teach them how to live without the family's largess. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 9-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. For 10 years on The Big Bang Theory, audiences have come to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. This single-camera, half-hour comedy gives us the chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

Meanwhile, Sheldon is upset when Dr. Sturgis assigns a group project and he is forced to work with two doubtful college students, Keith and Sam. Sheldon wants to do it individually, but Dr. Sturgis isn't making an exception for anyone. Georgie takes Missy to the mall where she sees Marcus, the boy she has a crush on. Georgie helps her talk to the boy and the siblings bond. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: Sheldon asks George to take him to a Stephen Hawking lecture in Pasadena. George declines because they can't afford it, so Sheldon tries to find a way they can travel for less money. Mary is curious if Georgie has a girlfriend, because he's been spending a lot of time with Jana. She wishes he would tell her things and complains about it to Meemaw. John has good news for Sheldon. The university will pay for his and George's trip to California. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: Newly unemployed Steve decides he doesn't really want to work, so he fritters away his days with the Bundys, visiting the zoo and taking fishing trips. This puts a strain on Steve's relationship with Marcy, who ends up going out with Al to a local bar, where they swap stories about their miserable marriages. But the conversation between Al and Marcy reaches its peak when Marcy has to decide whether to use the $25,000 reward she earned by foiling a bank robbery, sustaining a gunshot wound in the process, to buy a new car or to bail out Steve, who has been arrested for "rescuing" Bosco, the tortoise, from the local zoo. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Michael Bluth, a widower, wants nothing more than to be a good father to his 13-year-old son George Michael, so he resolves to quit the family business for good and move to Arizona to start a new life. But instead Michael's eccentric family pulls him back in when his father, George Bluth Sr., gets arrested for shift accounting practices at Bluth Co. This sends the family reeling, and when their assets are frozen, this puts a major crimp in each of their lives. Michael reluctantly finds himself having to pull his offbeat family up by their bootstraps and slowly teach them how to live without the family's largess. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.desc: Zakas ir Miri - geriausi draugai. Jie net gyvena kartu. Aišku, jie kartu gyvena ne iš gero gyvenimo: jiems abiems trūksta pinigų. Ir ne šiaip trūksta - jie finansinėje duobėje. programme.title: Taiklus šaulys.
programme.desc: Džimis (akt. Liamas Neesonas) - šlovingą karjerą užnugaryje palikęs profesionalus snaiperis. Šiandien vyras mėgaujasi ramia kasdienybe ir gyvenimu rančoje. Džimio ramybė baigiasi, kai JAV ir Meksikos pasienyje sutinka paauglį, tapusį įtakingos nusikaltėlių gaujos taikiniu. Užstojęs vaikį, Džimis įsivelia į katės ir pelės žaidimą, kuriame išgyventi gali tik vienas... Originalus pavadinimas "The Marksman". (The Marksman). [16+]. Nuotykių. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: Gucci mados namai.
programme.desc: Velnias iš tikrųjų dėvi ne "Prada", o "Gucci". Pasaulinio prekės ženklo šeimos istorija, kurioje netrūksta melo, išdavystės, keršto ir net nusikaltimų. Buvusi Maurizio Gucci žmona, Patrizia Reggiani, buvo apkaltinta savo vyro žmogžudystės užsakymu po to, kai ją paliko dėl jaunesnės moters. Skandalinga byla sukėlė šimtmečio teismą Italijoje. Režisieriaus Ridley'aus Scotto epinėje dramoje pagrindinius Patrizios bei Guccio Gucci vaikaičio M. Gucci vaidmenis atlieka garsioji atlikėja Lady Gaga bei naujasis "Žvaigždžių karų" veidas Adamas Driveris. Originalus pavadinimas "House of Gucci". (House of Gucci). [12+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. programme.title: Patriotų diena.
programme.desc: Režisierius Peter'is Berg'as ir aktorius Mark'as Wahlberg'as suvienija jėgas trileryje pagal tikrą istoriją. programme.title: Paskutinis oro gurkšnis.
programme.desc: Tikros istorijos įkvėptas filmas, pasakojantis apie kvapą gniaužiantį pasiaukojimą ir komandinio darbo sukurtą stebuklą. Trys ekspedicijoje dalyvaujantys narai patenka į nepavydėtiną padėtį, kai vienas iš jų, Krisas Lemonsas įkalinamas šimto pėdų gylyje be deguonies, elektros ir ryšio. Katastrofiškus padarinius galinti turėti kompiuterio klaida priverčia jo draugus Dankaną ir Deivą maksimaliai sutelkti savo protus ir patirtį. Juk tik nuo jų sugebėjimų priklauso įkalinto kolegos gyvybė. Lenktynės su laiku, kova su įsisiautėjusia vandenynų stichija ir lemtingos minutės, lemsiančios komandos likimą. (Last Breath). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Matrica: Perkrauta.
programme.desc: Antrojoje "Matricos" trilogijos dalyje visagalės mašinos sužino paskutinio žmonių miesto Ziono dislokacijos vietą. Kompiuteriai ketina iškasti tunelį Žemės šerdies link ir pasiųsti juo menkiausią judesį užfiksuojančius robotus-kamikadzes sentinelus, kurie sprogsta ir sunaikina viską aplinkui. (The Matrix Reloaded). [16+]. Veiksmo.

programme.title: 7 dienos Entebėje.
programme.desc: 1976 m. liepą "Air France" lėktuvas skrido iš Tel Avivo į Paryžių per Atėnus ir buvo užgrobtas. Lėktuvas nusileido Entebėje, Ugandoje. Keleiviai žydai buvo atskirti ir laikomi įkaitais. Palestiną palaikantys grobikai pareikalauja paleisti daugybę Izraelio kalėjimuose laikomų teroristų. Po ilgų diskusijų Izraelio vyriausybė išsiuntė elitinį padalinį, kuris surengtų reidą aerodrome ir išlaisvintų įkaitus. Neįtikėtina istorija apie gelbėjimo misiją, kuri pritraukė viso pasaulio dėmesį. Istorinis veiksmo draminis filmas – "7 dienos Entebėje". (7 Days in Entebbe). [12+]. Veiksmo. Trileriai. Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Aferistės.
programme.desc: Striptizą viename Niujorko klubų šokanti Ramona yra viena ilgiausiai klube išdirbusių šokėjų, tad vos galą su galu suduriančiai klubo naujokei Destinei ji tampa viskuo: patarėja, palaikytoja ir geriausia drauge. Kasnakt matant ciniškus, geismo ir godulio apimtus klubo klientus Ramonai kyla pyktis. Juk būtent jie - turtingi bankininkai, makleriai ir finansininkai - kalti, kad tokie žmonės kaip Destinė ir ji pati nemato šviesios dienos. Netrukus Ramona sukuria planą, kaip, pasitelkus savo patirtį ir darbe išmoktas gudrybes, būtų galima jiems atkeršyti. (Hustlers). Komedijos. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Matrica: Revoliucijos.
programme.desc: Ziono armija, padedama drąsių civilių savanorių, desperatiškai bando atsilaikyti prieš sentinelų invaziją. Zioniečių rankose - visos žmonijos ateitis. Tuo metu Neo laukia lemiamas mūšis su žiauriuoju agentu Smitu. (The Matrix Revolutions). [16+]. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Spartakas. Arenos dievai.
programme.desc: Matysime įvikius kaip atsirado spartakas. Batiatas daro pirmuosius žingsnius Luduso užkariavimui. Jaunasis čempijonas Ganikas pradžioje bus Capue žmonių širdyse. (Spartacus: Gods of the Arena). [14+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Nuotykių. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Antrasis šansas.
programme.desc: Pagrindinė filmo veikėja Maja jau nebe paauglė ar vos mokslus baigusi jaunuolė. Ji jau daugybę metų dirba mažmeninės prekybos parduotuvėje. Vieną dieną viskas pasikeičia - ji netikėtai pakviečiama darbo pokalbiui į kur kas prestižiškesnę įmonę pareigoms, apie kurias galėjo tik pasvajoti. Dar labiau moteris nustemba, kai pokalbio metu paaiškėja, jog darbdaviai ją laiko prestižinių universitetų alumne ir įspūdingą patirtį turinčia specialiste. (Second Act). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Aferistės.
programme.desc: Striptizą viename Niujorko klubų šokanti Ramona yra viena ilgiausiai klube išdirbusių šokėjų, tad vos galą su galu suduriančiai klubo naujokei Destinei ji tampa viskuo: patarėja, palaikytoja ir geriausia drauge. Kasnakt matant ciniškus, geismo ir godulio apimtus klubo klientus Ramonai kyla pyktis. Juk būtent jie - turtingi bankininkai, makleriai ir finansininkai - kalti, kad tokie žmonės kaip Destinė ir ji pati nemato šviesios dienos. Netrukus Ramona sukuria planą, kaip, pasitelkus savo patirtį ir darbe išmoktas gudrybes, būtų galima jiems atkeršyti. (Hustlers). Komedijos. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Spartakas. Kraujas ir smėlis.
programme.desc: Parduotas savo šalies. Atiduotas į vergovę. Atgimęs kariu. "Spartakas: kraujas ir smėlis" - tai išraiškingas pasakojimas apie patį įžymiausią romėnų gladiatorių. Spartaką išskyrė su jo gyvenimo meilę ir privertė eiti į areną, kur mirtis - geriausias minios pasilinksminimas. Spartakas privalo kautis už išgyvenimą, susidraugauti su priešais ir suvokti naujo gyvenimo žiaurumus, seksą ir šlovę. Jį gundys ir kankins kerštu. Bet jo aistra suteiks jam jėgų įveikti visus išbandymus šioje istorijoje apie mirtį ir garbę. (Spartacus). [18+]. Nuotykių. Veiksmo. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Non-stop.
programme.desc: Eilinis skrydis iš Niujorko į Londoną daug pasaulio mačiusiam oro maršalui Bilui Marksui nežada jokių staigmenų. Tačiau lėktuvui pakilus ir Bilui vos spėjus patogiai įsitaisyti, supypsi jo telefonas. Žinutė priverčia sunerimti - joje rašoma, kad kas dvidešimt minučių bus nužudytas vienas lėktuvo keleivis. Tol, kol į slaptą banko sąskaitą nebus pervesta 150 milijonų dolerių. Pirmoji mintis - kad kažkas suklydo arba pajuokavo. Tačiau netrukus Bilas gauna ir antrąją grėsmingą žinutę. Ir trečią. (Non-Stop). [12+]. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Mistika.

programme.title: Linkolnas.
programme.desc: Amerikiečių tauta įsitraukusi į pilietinį karą, kuriame žūsta daugybė žmonių. Prezidentas Abrahamas Linkolnas su aistra, žmogiškumu ir pasitelkdamas politinius gabumus imasi to, kas taps svarbiausiu jo palikimu: užbaigti karą ir 13-ąja pataisa visam laikui panaikinti vergiją. Rodydamas didžiulę drąsą, įžvalgumą ir moralinę tvirtybę, Linkolnas ragina tautą ir jam prieštaraujančius valdžios atstovus siekti didesnio gėrio visai žmonijai. (Lincoln). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Spartakas. Arenos dievai.
programme.desc: Matysime įvikius kaip atsirado spartakas. Batiatas daro pirmuosius žingsnius Luduso užkariavimui. Jaunasis čempijonas Ganikas pradžioje bus Capue žmonių širdyse. (Spartacus: Gods of the Arena). [14+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

1917 metų pavasarį Pirmasis pasaulinis karas visu pajėgumu drebina Europą. Britų karinė žvalgyba gauna informacijos, kad vienas jų batalionas žygiuoja tiesiai į priešo užimtą teritoriją. Kaip laiku perspėti 1600 karių, kas minutę artėjančių prie priešo linijos. Užduotis perduoti žinią apie pasalą patikima dviem jauniems eiliniams. Šofildas (George MacKay) ir Bleikas (George MacKay) privalo nepastebėti pereiti fronto liniją ir didžiulę priešo kontroliuojamą teritoriją. Tik sėkmės atveju šiaurės Prancūzijoje į pasalą žygiuojantys ginklo broliai liks gyvi. Neperdavus žinios, - jie žus visi iki vieno. Dviem šimtams apdovanojimų nominuota, šimtą trisdešimt keturis apdovanojimus, tarp jų ir tris Oskarus, laimėjusi karinė drama, kuri įtrauks ir nepaleis iki paskutinės minutės. (1917). Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: 127 Valandos.
programme.desc: Nieko neperspėjęs Aronas Ralstonas išsiruošia į kelionę po Jutos kanjonus. Netikėtai atskilęs pusę tonos sveriantis akmuo prispaudžia jo ranką ir įkalina tarpeklyje. Ralstonas žino, kad šioje vietoje jo niekas nesuras, nes apie kelionę niekam nepranešė. Per penkias įkalinimo dienas vyras permąsto savo gyvenimą, prisimena draugus, šeimą, meilužes ir viską įrašinėja nešiojama video kamera. Pasibaigus menkoms maisto ir vandens atsargoms, Aronas supranta, kad jei nesiims drastiškų veiksmų - jo laukia mirtis. Filmas paremtas tikra istorija. (127 Hours). Nuotykių. Dramos.

programme.title: Profas.
programme.desc: Kompiuterių įsilaužėlių amžiuje vienintelis saugus būdas išsaugoti ypač slaptą informaciją - patalpinti ją nieko apie tai nežinančios moksleivės galvoje. Štai kodėl kinų mafija 12 metų moksleivei Mei liepė įsiminti ypač slaptą skaičių seką. Netrukus nusikaltėlių pasaulyje pasklido gandas, kad mergaitės galvoje - neįkainuojamos vertės kodas, todėl vos Mei atvykus į Niujorką, prasidėjo jos medžioklė. Sprukdama nuo rusų mafijos, Mei paprašo pagalbos pirmo pasitaikiusio žmogaus - Luko (akt. Jasonas Stathamas), kuris iš tiesų yra elitinių policijos pajėgų agentas. Originalus pavadinimas "Safe". (Safe). Trileriai. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Spartakas. Arenos dievai.
programme.desc: Matysime įvikius kaip atsirado spartakas. Batiatas daro pirmuosius žingsnius Luduso užkariavimui. Jaunasis čempijonas Ganikas pradžioje bus Capue žmonių širdyse. (Spartacus: Gods of the Arena). [14+]. Veiksmo. Romantiniai. Nuotykių. Dramos.

programme.title: Skundikas.
programme.desc: Statybų kompanijos savininką Džoną šokiruoja žinia, kad jo nepilnametis sūnus kaltinamas narkotikų platinimu. Dabar jis areštuotas ir laukia galutinio nuosprendžio, žadančio 10 metų kalėjimo. Pasiryžęs bet kokia kaina išgelbėti sūnų, Džonas susitaria su prokuroru dirbti slaptuoju informatoriumi. Kad atliktų šią pavojingą užduotį, rizikuodamas viskuo, netgi savo šeima ir paties gyvybe, jis įsiskverbia į narkotikų kartelį. Jei gangsteriai iššifruos skundiką, bet kuris Džono žingsnis bus paskutinis - tiek slaptoje operacijoje, tiek gyvenime. Režisierius Ricas Romanas Waughas, vaidina Dwayne'as Johnsonas, Susan Sarandon ir kt. (Snitch). [12+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Kieti bičai.
programme.desc: Ne patį sėkmingiausią laikotarpį išgyvenantis privatus detektyvas Holandas ir efektyviai ir greitai legaliai nesutvarkomas užsakovų problemas sprendžiantis Džeksonas kartu privalo surasti dingusią merginą. Džeksonas priverstas ne tik saugotis pats, bet ir saugoti savo naują sąjungininką, nes detektyvas nuolat įsipainioja į keistas situacijas. O jų maža tikrai nebus: korumpuoti policijos pareigūnai, Holivudo spindesys, nužudyta buvusi pornografijos žvaigždė, ant kulnų lipantys žmogžudžiai, keisti sutapimai ir dar keistesnės mirtys - viskas susipina į didžiulį paslapčių, pavojų ir nesusipratimų kamuolį. O siūlo galas azarto apimtus porininkus nuves iki pat aukščiausių valdžios sluoksnių. (The Nice Guys). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Nepageidaujami genai.
programme.desc: Vaikų susilaukti trokštančiai Keisei (akt. Jennifer Aniston) niekaip nepavyksta sutikti to vienintelio, tad moteris nusprendžia palikuonio susilaukti pasitelkus dirbtinį apvaisinimą. Ir net surengia vakarėlį genialiai idėjai aplaistyti. Šventėje Keisės geriausias draugas Volis (akt. Jason Bateman), kuris yra slapta ją įsimylėjęs, padaugina svaigiųjų gėrimų ir iškrečia kvailystę. Vakarėlis pasibaigia, Volis beveik nieko nepamena, o Keisė išsikrausto iš Niujorko, nes mano, kad tai netinkama vieta auginti vaiką. Po septynerių metų ji grįžta su sūneliu Sebastianu ir nori surasti donorą bei jo biologinį tėvą Rolandą, kad šis labiau įsitrauktų į berniuko gyvenimą, tačiau Volis, susipažinęs su Sebastianu, pastebi neįtikėtinai daug panašumų... Ką visa tai reiškia? (The Switch). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Švytėjimas.
programme.desc: Šeima atvažiuoja per žiemą prižiūrėti atokaus viešbučio, kur piktavališka jėga pastūmėja tėvą imtis smurto. Tuo pat metu jo aiškiaregys sūnus mato šiurpias praeities ir ateities vizijas. (The Shining). [18+]. Trileriai. Dramos. Siaubo.

programme.title: Infiltruoti.
programme.desc: Filmo veiksmas vyksta Bostone, kur airių mafijos bosas Frensis "Frenkas" Kostelas slapta įdarbina Koliną Salivaną kaip šnipą į Masučusetso valstijos policijos komisariatą. Tuo pat metu policija paskiria slapta dirbančiam policininkui Viljamui "Biliui" Kostiganui infiltruotis į Kostelo grupuotę. Kai abi pusės suvokia situaciją, abu vyrai mėgina nustatyti viens kito tapatybę pirmiau už kitą. (The Departed). [18+]. Dramos. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Nemirtingieji.
programme.desc: Senovės Graikija. Despotiškas ir kraugeriškas karalius Hiperionas bei žiauri jo žmogžudžių armija leidžiasi į prieš daugybę metų dingusio Epyro lanko paieškas. Tikima, kad tas, kurio rankose šis lankas - nenugalimas, tad Hiperionas užsigeidžia bet kokia kaina jį gauti. Jis viliasi, kad su nenugalimuoju ginklu jam pavyks nuversti Olimpo dievus ir tapti galingiausiu viso pasaulio valdovu. Hiperionas ir nuožmusis jo legionas keliauja per Senovės Graikijos miestus ir kaimus ir be gailesčio naikina visus pasipainiojus jų kelyje. Rodos, niekas negalėtų jų sustabdyti. (Immortals). Dramos. Romantiniai. Veiksmo. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Slaptasis agentas.
programme.desc: Kažkada viena sumaniausių ir labiausiai vertinamų Centrinės Žvalgybos Agentūros užsienio agenčių Alisa padarė klaidą, kuri jai kainavo karjerą. Dabar moteris atlieka nuobodžias užduotis biure ir gali tik svajoti apie aktyvią agentės veiklą. Tačiau vieną dieną viskas pasikeičia. Gaunama žinių apie Londone planuojamą biologinio ginklo išpuolį. Alisa yra daugiausiai žinių ir patirties šioje srityje turinti agentė, tad CŽV vadai gražina ją į ankstesnes pareigas. Alisa turi labai nedaug laiko, kad išsiaiškintų detales apie planuojamą išpuolį. (Unlocked). [14+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Spartakas. Arenos dievai.
programme.desc: Matysime įvikius kaip atsirado spartakas. Batiatas daro pirmuosius žingsnius Luduso užkariavimui. Jaunasis čempijonas Ganikas pradžioje bus Capue žmonių širdyse. (Spartacus: Gods of the Arena). [14+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Romantiniai. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Adrenalinas.
programme.desc: Ankstyvą rytą Čevą pažadina netikėtas skambutis. Vaikinas sunkiai praplėšia akis, jausdamas, kad beveik negali pajudėti, o širdis vos vos plaka. Balsas kitame laido gale Čevui liepia pažiūrėti video juostą, paaiškinančią tiek jo prastos savijautos, tiek ankstyvo skambučio priežastis. Verslo konkurentas Rikis Verona praneša Čevui, kad jam buvo suleista dozė nuodų, vadinamų "Pekino kokteiliu" ir ši mikstūra vaikiną nužudys per valandą. Todėl po telefono skambučio vaikinui belieka sutelkti visas pastangas ir ropštis iš lovos. Kitaip jo gyvybė per valandą užges... (Crank). [16+]. Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Profas.
programme.desc: Kompiuterių įsilaužėlių amžiuje vienintelis saugus būdas išsaugoti ypač slaptą informaciją - patalpinti ją nieko apie tai nežinančios moksleivės galvoje. Štai kodėl kinų mafija 12 metų moksleivei Mei liepė įsiminti ypač slaptą skaičių seką. Netrukus nusikaltėlių pasaulyje pasklido gandas, kad mergaitės galvoje - neįkainuojamos vertės kodas, todėl vos Mei atvykus į Niujorką, prasidėjo jos medžioklė. Sprukdama nuo rusų mafijos, Mei paprašo pagalbos pirmo pasitaikiusio žmogaus - Luko (akt. Jasonas Stathamas), kuris iš tiesų yra elitinių policijos pajėgų agentas. Originalus pavadinimas "Safe". (Safe). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Šeima.
programme.desc: Bruklino nusikaltėlis Giovanni Manzoni (De Niro) turėjo viską, kol vieną dieną netapo išdaviku. Kad ir kiek kartų agentas Stansfield (Tommy Lee Jones) perkelia Giovanni ir jo šeimą, pavojus visada šalia. Kai šeimą vėl suranda, Giovanni, jo žmoną Maggie (Michelle Pfeiffer), ir jų dvejus vaikus Warren (John D'Leo) ir Belle (Dianna Agron) perkelia į ramų kaimelį Prancūzijoje. Atrodo, jog tai yra ideali vieta pabėgti nuo kriminalų keliamo pavojaus, tačiau ši nusikaltėlių pasaulio patirties turinti šeima sugrįžta prie nešvarių darbelių, taip dar kartą pakliūdami po sindikato radaru. programme.title: Ugnimi prieš ugnį.
programme.desc: Tapęs parduotuvės savininko ir jo sūnaus žmogžudystės liudininku, ugniagesys Džeremis Kolmanas pats vos išneša sveiką kailį. Policija sulaiko už žmogžudystes atsakingą mafijos bosą ir prašo Džeremio pagalbos jį nuteisiant. Ugniagesys įtraukiamas į liudininkų apsaugos programą. Nors nusikaltėlis pasodinamas už grotų, neilgai trukus advokatas suorganizuoja jo paleidimą. Džeremio ir jo merginos gyvybėms iškyla pavojus. Kai neįmanoma pasislėpti, reikia kautis. Įtempto siužeto trileris. (Fire with Fire). Dramos. Veiksmo. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Koriolanas.
programme.desc: Tai legendinio rašytojo Viljamo Šekspyro tragedijos "Koriolanas" adaptacija. Originali istorija pasakojan apie iš Romos ištremtą didvyrį, kuris susivienija su savo priešu tam, kad atkeršytų saviems už tokį "dėkingumą". Filme pasakojimo veiksmas perkeliamas į šiuos laikus. Tai istorija apie žmogų, kuris kovėsi už savo šalį, bet buvo uždarytas į kalėjimą ir apkaltintas išdavyste. Kaip šiuolaikinis herojus pasuks legendinį pasakojimą? (Coriolanus). Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Nepageidaujami genai.
programme.desc: Vaikų susilaukti trokštančiai Keisei (akt. Jennifer Aniston) niekaip nepavyksta sutikti to vienintelio, tad moteris nusprendžia palikuonio susilaukti pasitelkus dirbtinį apvaisinimą. Ir net surengia vakarėlį genialiai idėjai aplaistyti. Šventėje Keisės geriausias draugas Volis (akt. Jason Bateman), kuris yra slapta ją įsimylėjęs, padaugina svaigiųjų gėrimų ir iškrečia kvailystę. Vakarėlis pasibaigia, Volis beveik nieko nepamena, o Keisė išsikrausto iš Niujorko, nes mano, kad tai netinkama vieta auginti vaiką. Po septynerių metų ji grįžta su sūneliu Sebastianu ir nori surasti donorą bei jo biologinį tėvą Rolandą, kad šis labiau įsitrauktų į berniuko gyvenimą, tačiau Volis, susipažinęs su Sebastianu, pastebi neįtikėtinai daug panašumų... Ką visa tai reiškia? (The Switch). Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Pabėgimas iš Šoušenko.
programme.desc: Pasakojama Endžio istorija, kuris apkaltinamas žmonos nužudymu ir nuteisiamas kalėti iki gyvos galvos. Kalėjime Endis susipažįsta su kitu kaliniu - Elisu. Filme pasakojama apie ilgus kalėjimo metus ir kaip tokiose sąlygose išlaikyti savo žmogiškumą. (The Shawshank Redemption). Dramos.

programme.title: Spartakas. Kraujas ir smėlis.
programme.desc: Spartakas sugrįžta. Jau šiame sezone sužinosite, kaip jam sekėsi pabėgus iš kruvinosios gladiatorių mokyklos, kartu su kitais likimo broliais. Ištrūkusi gauja pradeda šiurpinti Romėnų respubliką. Jie siekia keršto už tai ką patyrė, yra stiprūs ir pikti. Spartakas turi pasirinkti ar siekti asmeninio keršto prieš vyrą, kuris pasmerkė jo žmoną vergovei ir mirčiai ar siekti didžiulio keršto prieš visą Romėnų imperiją? (Spartacus). [18+]. Romantiniai. Nuotykių. Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Ties riba į rytojų.
programme.desc: Kaip jaustumėtės jeigu žinotumėt, kad mirtis ne pabaiga, o šansas pasirodyti geriau? Misijoje prieš ateivius žuvęs pulkininkas Bilas Keidžas prabunda artėjant karui. Istorijai pasikartojus dar kelis kartus, jis suvokia patekęs į laiko kilpą. Tačiau žmogus adaptuojasi ir kaskart išgyvena vis ilgiau, o jo įgūdžiai gerėja. Laukia lemiama kova prieš ateivių rasę į kurią Bilą lydės kai kas, jau patyręs šį fenomeną. Fantastinė veiksmo juosta su pirmo ryškumo žvaigždėmis Tomu Cruise'u ir Emily Blunt. Originalus pavadinimas "Edge of Tomorrow". (Edge of Tomorrow). [12+]. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

Laukia lemiama kova prieš ateivių rasę į kurią Bilą lydės kai kas, jau patyręs šį fenomeną. Fantastinė veiksmo juosta su pirmo ryškumo žvaigždėmis Tomu Cruise'u ir Emily Blunt. Originalus pavadinimas "Edge of Tomorrow". (Edge of Tomorrow). [12+]. Nuotykių. Veiksmo.

programme.title: A komanda.
programme.desc: Apie buvusius fiktyvaus Jungtinių Valstijų armijos specialiųjų pajėgų dalinio narius. Keturi komandos nariai buvo teisiami karo lauko teisme už nusikaltimą, kurio jie nepadarė. (The A-Team). Nuotykių. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Lapkričio žmogus.
programme.desc: Peteris - itin patyręs ir aukštos klasifikacijos, puikiai treniruotas buvęs CŽV agentas. Šnipų pasaulyje jis buvo žinomas "Lapkričio žmogaus" slapyvardžiu, tačiau jau kuris laikas Peteris mėgaujasi užtarnautu poilsiu ir ramiu gyvenimu Šveicarijoje. Tiksliau - mėgavosi, kol jį ir vėl įvyliojo į pavojų kupiną slaptųjų agentų pasaulį. Tikėdamasis, kad tai bus jau tikrai paskutinė jo byla ir negalėjęs jos atsisakyti dėl asmeniškumų, jis įsitrauks į pavojingiausią žaidimą savo karjeroje. (The November Man). Veiksmo. Nuotykių. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Šventasis Vincentas.
programme.desc: Jaunas vaikinas, kurio tėvai ką tik išsiskyrė, randa netikėtą draugą ir mentorių - kaimynystėje gyvenantį misantropišką, vulgarų, hedonistišką karo veteraną. (St. Vincent). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Spartakas. Kraujas ir smėlis.
programme.desc: Spartakas sugrįžta. Jau šiame sezone sužinosite, kaip jam sekėsi pabėgus iš kruvinosios gladiatorių mokyklos, kartu su kitais likimo broliais. Ištrūkusi gauja pradeda šiurpinti Romėnų respubliką. Jie siekia keršto už tai ką patyrė, yra stiprūs ir pikti. Spartakas turi pasirinkti ar siekti asmeninio keršto prieš vyrą, kuris pasmerkė jo žmoną vergovei ir mirčiai ar siekti didžiulio keršto prieš visą Romėnų imperiją? (Spartacus). [18+]. Veiksmo. Romantiniai. Nuotykių. Dramos.

programme.title: Ta nejauki akimirka.
programme.desc: Zacas Efronas, Michaelas B. Jordanas ir Miles'as Telleris vaidina tris geriausius draugus - Džeisoną, Maikį ir Danielį, kurie nuolat išgyvena tą nejaukią akimirką, kai santykiuose reikia nuspręsti: "o kas toliau?". Visos Džeisono draugystės baigiasi būtent po šio klausimo - jis tiesiog nemoka įsipareigoti, tad eilinį kartą vėl lieka vienas. Jo draugas ir kolega, kartu kuriantis knygų viršelius, Danielis apskritai seniai neturėjo santykių, o trečiasis - gydytoju dirbantis Maikis - kaip tyčia gauna žmonos skyrybų prašymą. Trijulė nusprendžia savo vienišumą aplaistyti bare. Čia jie sutinka vienišiaus Danielio bičiulę Čelsę, Džeisonas ima flirtuoti su Ele, o Maikis gauna Keitės numerį. Ar tai gali būti nauja pradžia kiekvieno iš jų gyvenime ir kada vėl ateis ta nejauki akimirka, kai reiks spręsti, o kas toliau... Tačiau visi vyrai bare pasižadėjo niekam neįsipareigoti. Ar pavyks išsaugoti viengungių priesaiką? (That Awkward Moment). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.desc: Filme pasakojama, kaip 2008 m. finansų krizės pradžioje per 24 valandas gyvena svarbiausi investicinio banko darbuotojai. (Margin Call). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Viešpatavimas.
programme.desc: Dr. Vilas Kasteris yra garsiausias dirbtinio intelekto tyrinėtojas, kuriantis mokslinę technologiją, kuri sujungs visų laikų žiniomis pagrįstą intelektą ir visą žmogiškų emocijų spektrą. Itin kontraversiški eksperimentai jį išgarsino, bet taip pat pavertė pagrindiniu su technologijomis kovojančių ekstremistų taikiniu, o šie padarys viską, kad tik mokslininką sustabdytų. Tačiau siekdami sužlugdyti Vilą jie neišvengiamai padės jam žengti dar vieną žingsnį — persikelti į sistemą ir pratęsti savo būtį. (Transcendence). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Trys stendai prie Ebingo, Misūryje.
programme.desc: Praėjus septyniems mėnesiams nuo tragiškos dukters žūties, Mildred vis dar neturi atsakymo, kas pražudė jos vaiką. Užpuolikas ne tik nenubaustas, bet ir nerastas. Trūkus kantrybei dėl apatiškos policijos, moteris metams išsinuomoja tris didžiulius reklaminius stendus laukuose įvažiuojant į miestelį. Ant ryškiai raudonų iš tolo šviečiančių iškabų didžiulėmis raidėmis Mildred kreipiasi į policijos viršininką: kodėl žudikas iki šiol nerastas? Keistomis iškabomis susidomi ne tik miestelio gyventojai, bet ir televizijos reporteriai. Policijos pareigūnai niršta, o Mildred pareiškia, kad tai tik pradžia. Filmas apdovanotas dviem "Oskarais" ir keturiais "Auksiniais gaubliais". Iš viso pelnė 132 prizus ir 233 nominacijas. (Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri). Komedijos. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Magiškasis Maikas XXL.
programme.desc: Praėjo jau treji metai, kai Maikas atsisakė naktinio gyvenimo ir erotinių šokių. Netikėtai jis susitinka buvusios šokių grupės draugus ir nusprendžia paskutinį kartą sudalyvauti šokių konkurse. Merginų kraują kaitinantys ir aistras išlaisvinantys vyrukai su Magiškuoju Maiku priešakyje vėl žengs į sceną. Erotikos kupino filmo režisierius Gregory Jacobsas, vadina Channingas Tatumas. Originalus pavadinimas "Magic Mike XXL". (Magic Mike XXL). [12+]. Dramos. Muzikiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Better Man: Robbie Williams istorija.
programme.desc: Tai tikra istorija apie vieną didžiausių pramogų pasaulio talentų - britų popmuzikos superžvaigždę Robbie Williamsą: jo svaiginantį išgarsėjimą, dramatišką nuopuolį ir nepaprastą sugrįžimą į didžiąją sceną. (Better Man). [16+].

programme.title: Vykdytojas.
programme.desc: Verslininkas bei laimingai vedęs vyras netyčia padaro nusikaltimą. Nuteistas kalėti, jis turi prisitaikyti ir išmokti išgyventi kalėjimo sąlygomis. Čia privalai tapti kovotoju, autoritetu arba auka. Jis stengiasi nepridaryti problemų, jog vėl galėtų pamatyti savo šeimą. Tačiau jo pasirinkimai kalėjime turės didelių padarinių tiek jam pačiam, tiek jo artimiesiems. Kai kurie vyrai nusikaltėliais tampa kalėjime. Gyvenimo už grotų žiauri kasdienybė kriminaliniame trileryje – "Mirtinas šūvis". (Shot Caller). Trileriai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Zakas ir Miri kuria porno.
programme.desc: Zakas ir Miri - geriausi draugai. Jie net gyvena kartu. Aišku, jie kartu gyvena ne iš gero gyvenimo: jiems abiems trūksta pinigų. Ir ne šiaip trūksta - jie finansinėje duobėje. Zaką ir Miri net ruošiasi iškraustyti iš buto, o skolų kalnas netrukus juos palaidos. Ką daryti? Netikėtai tapę žvaigždėmis olandiškame Youtube su trumpučiu - ir ne visai padoriu - filmuku, Zakas ir Miri sumąsto planą, kaip prasimanyti pinigų: jie kurs namudinį pornofilmą! (Zack and Miri Make a Porno). [18+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Taiklus šaulys.
programme.desc: Džimis (akt. Liamas Neesonas) - šlovingą karjerą užnugaryje palikęs profesionalus snaiperis. Šiandien vyras mėgaujasi ramia kasdienybe ir gyvenimu rančoje. Džimio ramybė baigiasi, kai JAV ir Meksikos pasienyje sutinka paauglį, tapusį įtakingos nusikaltėlių gaujos taikiniu. Užstojęs vaikį, Džimis įsivelia į katės ir pelės žaidimą, kuriame išgyventi gali tik vienas... Originalus pavadinimas "The Marksman". (The Marksman). [16+]. Veiksmo. Nuotykių. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: A komanda.
programme.desc: Apie buvusius fiktyvaus Jungtinių Valstijų armijos specialiųjų pajėgų dalinio narius. Keturi komandos nariai buvo teisiami karo lauko teisme už nusikaltimą, kurio jie nepadarė. (The A-Team). Nuotykių. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Gucci mados namai.
programme.desc: Velnias iš tikrųjų dėvi ne "Prada", o "Gucci". Pasaulinio prekės ženklo šeimos istorija, kurioje netrūksta melo, išdavystės, keršto ir net nusikaltimų. Buvusi Maurizio Gucci žmona, Patrizia Reggiani, buvo apkaltinta savo vyro žmogžudystės užsakymu po to, kai ją paliko dėl jaunesnės moters. Skandalinga byla sukėlė šimtmečio teismą Italijoje. Režisieriaus Ridley'aus Scotto epinėje dramoje pagrindinius Patrizios bei Guccio Gucci vaikaičio M. Gucci vaidmenis atlieka garsioji atlikėja Lady Gaga bei naujasis "Žvaigždžių karų" veidas Adamas Driveris. Originalus pavadinimas "House of Gucci". (House of Gucci). [12+]. Dramos. Kriminalai. Trileriai.
