programme.title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom.
programme.desc: Biopic that sees Idris Elba play the South African lawyer who campaigned restlessly against apartheid in the 1940s before becoming one of the greatest leaders of the modern age. It chronicles Nelson Mandela's journey from childhood in a rural village, to prominent figure in a political movement striving for equality, to 27 years of imprisonment, and finally to his inauguration as South Africa's president. (Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Is Anybody There?.
programme.desc: In 1987 Edward (Bill Milner) is a ten-year-old boy who lives at an old people's home run by his parents (David Morrissey and Anne-Marie Duff). Surrounded by death and dying, he becomes obsessed with finding evidence for the afterlife, often using a tape recorder to capture his "encounters". He is helped in his search by Clarence (Michael Caine), an elderly ex-magician in the early stages of dementia who has recently entered the home. The film follows their quest and their friendship, which ultimately allows both Edward and Clarence to come to terms with their respective situations. (Is Anybody There?). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Nightcap.
programme.desc: In Lausanne, the aspirant pianist Jeanne Pollet has lunch with her mother Louise Pollet, her boyfriend Axel and his mother. Lenna leans that when she was born, a nurse had mistakenly told to the prominent pianist André Polonski that she would be his daughter. André has just remarried his first wife, the heiress of a Swiss chocolate factory Marie-Claire "Mika" Muller and they live in Lausanne with André's son Guillaume Polonski. Out of the blue, Jeanne visits André and he offers to give piano classes to help her in her examination. Jeanne becomes closer to André and sooner she discovers that Mika might be drugging her stepson with Rohypnol. Further, she might have killed his second wife Lisbeth. (Merci pour le chocolat). [16+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Nostalgia.
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles (Nostalgia). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob.
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy from director Charles Crichton. Alec Guinness stars as a mild-mannered transporter of gold bullion. He has been doing the job for the past 20 years honestly enough, but suddenly decides to steal a million pounds. He enlists the help of paperweight manufacturer Stanley Holloway and the men hijack the bank's armoured car. Once in their hands, the gold bars are melted down and formed into small, souvenir Eiffel Towers. But after the booty is smuggled out to Paris, it is purchased by a group of English schoolgirls. As a result of their pleading with the girls, the gang retrieve all but one of the towers. But the last one is in the hands of a very determined student, and she refuses to part with it... With Sid James, Alfie Bass and Majorie Fielding. (The Lavender Hill Mob). Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: A Girl Missing.
programme.desc: A home-care nurse's relationship with the family she has spent years working for is threatened when her nephew is arrested for kidnapping their daughter. (Yokogao). Dramos.

programme.title: Eye of the Storm.
programme.desc: Isabelle Gagnon, a single mother of three, shows that custody can be shared, but it's not without struggle. She will have to weather the storm in order to find new friendship and new love. (L'oeil du cyclone). Dramos.

programme.title: Costa Brava, Lebanon.
programme.desc: Members of a family who quit the polluted, rubbish-strewn city of Beirut for an idyllic mountain home. However, their dreams of a utopian existence are shattered by the construction of a landfill on the boundary of their land. (Costa Brava, Lebanon). Dramos.

programme.title: Pride.
programme.desc: PRIDE is an inspirational comedy based on remarkable true events. It's the summer of 1984 - Margaret Thatcher is in power and the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) is on strike. At the Gay Pride March in London, a group of gay and lesbian activists decides to raise money to support the families of the striking miners. But there is a problem. The Union seems embarrassed to receive their support. But the activists are not deterred. They decide to ignore the Union and go direct to the miners. They identify a mining village in deepest Wales and set off in a mini bus to make their donation in person. And so begins the extraordinary story of how two wholly different communities come together for a common cause. (Pride). Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Tale of Cinema.
programme.desc: As the film begins, Sangwon, an aimless and indecisive college student on school holiday after final examinations, avoids walking together with his older brother by instead taking a side street, where he finds a former girlfriend, Yongsil, working at an optician's store. Unsure of his own emotional preparedness in rekindling the relationship, he decides to watch a play while waiting for her to complete her work shift, delaying the decision to meet her later in the evening. The final words of anguish in the play, uttered by a desperately ill child unable to be comforted by his mother, would later be echoed by Sangwon from the rooftop of his parents' apartment after his own failed act of despair. In the film's corollary chapter, Tongsu, a struggling, rootless, and inscrutable filmmaker who has become obsessed with a short film directed by his former classmate - and in particular, the devoted and obliging woman in the film - encounters the young actress in person and begins to ingratiate himself into her company, acting out his projected image of her by imitating gestures and revisiting locations from the film in an attempt to realize his own created image of her. (Tale of Cinema). Dramos.

programme.title: Lou!.
programme.desc: Lou spends her days eating takeout, playing with her cat and spying on a hunky neighbor, but when her mom falls in love, her life takes a sudden turn. (Lou !). Komedijos.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert.
programme.desc: Drama ''Last Days in the Desert'' follows Jesus in an imagined chapter from his 40 days of fasting and praying in the desert. On his way out of the wilderness, he struggles with Satan over the fate of an ordinary family in crisis, setting for himself a dramatic test with distinctly human conflicts. (Last Days in the Desert). [12+]. Nuotykių. Dramos.

programme.title: Swimming with Men.
programme.desc: When accountant Eric, (Brydon), seeks to win back his wife Heather (Horrocks), he stumbles upon a solution in the form of a male synchronised swimming team: Men Who Swim. Joining his local team, Eric finds brotherhood in this crew as they train for the world championships in Milan. (Swimming with Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride.
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders). (The Decoy Bride). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Summer We Live.
programme.desc: Year 1998. Isabel, a journalism student, is forced to do her internship in the newspaper of a small Galician coastal town in order to finish her degree. When she arrives, she wants to start investigating as soon as possible, to demonstrate everything she has learned in order to become a real journalist. But the position she is assigned is the last one she expected: the writing and management of the obituaries that reach the newsroom. But this, which might seem boring at first, becomes the door to an investigation that will take her through different parts of the Spanish geography in search of an impossible love story. (El verano que vivimos). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park.
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability. (Mi amiga del parque). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Graduate.
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel. (The Graduate). [16+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Braves.
programme.desc: Margaux and Alma share a love of the theatre. Although sometimes finding themselves competing for a role, they remain best friends. Despite everything, they make progress and seem unstoppable. Alma and Margot's relationship really is ''for better and for worse''. (Entre les vagues). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: My Heart Can't Beat Unless You Tell It To.
programme.desc: Writer and director Jonathan Cuartas twists the traditional vampire horror trope into a gritty kitchen-sink drama. Two older siblings look after their younger brother, who's a vampire, by killing to source blood for him. Forget capes. Forget beautiful familiars and neck biting. Forget huge castles nestled precariously on cliffs in some godforsaken forest. This is vampirism John Osborne style. Three siblings live together in a claustrophobic suburban house with an interior the colour of a well-used tea pot. In the opening scene, the eldest, Dwight (Patrick Fugit), kills a homeless man and takes him back to the house where he and his sister Jessie (Ingrid Sophie Schram) drain the corpse into a corrugated metal bin with a tap. They then decant the blood into the bowl and take it to their ailing younger brother Thomas (Owen Campbell), who's apparently catatonic in bed. As he drinks the claret, Thomas revives. And so it goes on. Jessie works as a waiter in a diner and lets Dwight know if she spots a potential kill. Dwight is at the end of his tether and doesn't want to do this anymore. But Jessie reminds him that it's for their little brother. Teenage Thomas hears other kids playing outside and naturally wants to join them. But how can they break the cycle without breaking their family? Network Premiere. (My Heart Can'T Beat Unless You Tell It To). Siaubo. Dramos.

programme.title: Kalinka.
programme.desc: Based on the story of Andre Bamberski, who fought to bring his daughter's presumed murderer to justice for 27 years. (Au nom de ma fille). Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: The Scouting Book For Boys.
programme.desc: This is England '86 director Tom Harper made his feature debut with this poetic but ultimately dark tale of teenage love, starring Thomas Turgoose (also of This is England heritage) and Holliday Grainger (TV's The Borgias). Emily (Grainger) and David (Turgoose) have grown up together on a caravan park in Norfolk. His father is the onsite entertainer, while her mother runs the resort's shop. But when Emily's estranged father reveals his intention to take her away, Emily turns to David for help. Having long carried a torch for her, he immediately offers to help her hide out in a nearby cave. But as a manhunt gets underway to find the missing girl, it not only becomes apparent that this solution isn't going to work, but their relationship also begins to morph into something darker... Also starring Steven Mackintosh, Susan Lynch and Rafe Spall. (The Scouting Book for Boys). Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Robe Of Gems.
programme.desc: Isabel and her family take possession of her mother's villa in rural Mexico where they reconnect with their long-time domestic worker Maria. But things have never been the same since Isabel's mother left. Once so well looked after, the house is now bare and neglected. Isabel and her husband are growing apart, and their children are increasingly worried about them. Maria's sister's disappearance has left her family in distress and forced her to engage in criminal activities with Adan, the son of a local policeman. Isabel decides to go on a dangerous quest, neglecting her own children, as well as her housekeeper's warning that she does not understand how things work in Mexico's poorer regions. (Robe Of Gems). Dramos. Mistika. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Sol.
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël. (Sol). [16+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: All Our Desires.
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor. (Toutes nos envies). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Something in the Air.
programme.desc: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas, Something in the Air is a poignant, semi-autobiographical film set in France a few years after the huge political and civil unrest of 1968, a borderline revolution that almost brought the country to a standstill. In 1971, a group of teenagers are still feeling the momentum of the movement, alongside disappointment that the dust is settling with little apparent change. Gilles (Clément Métayer) is finishing up at school and getting ready for art college, but his mind is filled with hard (and often conflicting) political ideologies, and as debates turn into demonstrations, and demonstrations turn into violent attacks against state, he meets more people who are angry with the political status quo, including Christine (Lola Créton), who's part of a film-making movement that celebrates the working class. Something in the Air is a moving and sometimes funny film about social inequality, and pays sound attention to a fascinating point of recent European history that is often overlooked. (Something in the Air). Dramos.

programme.title: Summer White.
programme.desc: Rodrigo is a solitary teenager, a king in the private world he shares with his mother. Things change when she takes her new boyfriend home to live. He must decide if he fights for his throne and crushes the happiness of the person he loves the most. (Blanco de verano). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Last Emperor.
programme.desc: In 1950, Puyi has been kept in custody for five years, since the Red Army captured him during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. In the recently established People's Republic of China, Puyi arrives as a political prisoner and war criminal at the Fushun War Criminals Management Centre. Soon after his arrival, Puyi attempts suicide, but is quickly revived and told he must stand trial. (The Last Emperor). [12+]. Dramos.

Mistika. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring.
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master. (Girl with a Pearl Earring). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee.
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together. (Neem me mee). [16+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Comment c'est loin.
programme.desc: After ten years of doing nothing, Orel and Gringe are in their mid 30s and they struggle to finish their first rap album. Their texts are mostly sex jokes and booze stories and reflect the everyday life they have in a small town from France. The problem is that they never really finished a song and when their producers want to meet, they have to face a new challenge : finish their first song in the next 24h. Their old issues, the fear of failure, their alcoholic friends and annoying girlfriends won't help them to do so, or will they ? (Comment c'est loin). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Answer Man.
programme.desc: Everyone wants to meet Arlen Faber (Jeff Daniels), the world-famous author of the best-selling spiritual book ''Me and God'', but crotchety, disgruntled Arlen simply wants to be left alone, and so far he's been successful at keeping his identity a secret. But all that changes when troubled bookstore owner Kris Lucas (Lou Taylor Pucci) discovers his home address and barters books for Arlen's words of wisdom, and a back injury leads the reclusive writer to date chiropractor and overprotective single mother Elizabeth (Lauren Graham). As Arlen's relationships with his newfound friends grow, he must come to terms with his past and the realization that he doesn't hold all the answers. (Arlen Faber). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: When Pigs Have Wings.
programme.desc: After a tempest, fishermen do not find only fish in their nets. That is what happens to Jafaar, a poor fisherman who lives poorly in Gaza. And what he hauls in is really upsetting : imagine that, a pig! An unclean animal judged impure not only by the Faith of Islam but also by the Jewish religion. Determined to get rid of the animal, Jafaar tries desperately to sell it, first to a United Nations official, then to a Jewish colony where Yelena raises pigs not for their meat but for security reasons. Of course, going unnoticed in the company of a "forbidden" animal, among his Palestinian brothers, past Israeli soldiers and under the scrutiny of Islamic fundamentalists is no bed of roses and a series of misadventures await Jafaar.... (When Pigs Have Wings). Komedijos.

programme.title: Eye of the Storm.
programme.desc: Isabelle Gagnon, a single mother of three, shows that custody can be shared, but it's not without struggle. She will have to weather the storm in order to find new friendship and new love. (L'oeil du cyclone). Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Kriminalai. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Muzikiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Is Anybody There?.
programme.desc: In 1987 Edward (Bill Milner) is a ten-year-old boy who lives at an old people's home run by his parents (David Morrissey and Anne-Marie Duff). Surrounded by death and dying, he becomes obsessed with finding evidence for the afterlife, often using a tape recorder to capture his "encounters". He is helped in his search by Clarence (Michael Caine), an elderly ex-magician in the early stages of dementia who has recently entered the home. The film follows their quest and their friendship, which ultimately allows both Edward and Clarence to come to terms with their respective situations. (Is Anybody There?). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Nightcap.
programme.desc: In Lausanne, the aspirant pianist Jeanne Pollet has lunch with her mother Louise Pollet, her boyfriend Axel and his mother. Lenna leans that when she was born, a nurse had mistakenly told to the prominent pianist André Polonski that she would be his daughter. André has just remarried his first wife, the heiress of a Swiss chocolate factory Marie-Claire "Mika" Muller and they live in Lausanne with André's son Guillaume Polonski. Out of the blue, Jeanne visits André and he offers to give piano classes to help her in her examination. Jeanne becomes closer to André and sooner she discovers that Mika might be drugging her stepson with Rohypnol. Further, she might have killed his second wife Lisbeth. (Merci pour le chocolat). [16+]. Mistika. Dramos. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Nostalgia.
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles (Nostalgia). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob.
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy from director Charles Crichton. Alec Guinness stars as a mild-mannered transporter of gold bullion. He has been doing the job for the past 20 years honestly enough, but suddenly decides to steal a million pounds. He enlists the help of paperweight manufacturer Stanley Holloway and the men hijack the bank's armoured car. Once in their hands, the gold bars are melted down and formed into small, souvenir Eiffel Towers. But after the booty is smuggled out to Paris, it is purchased by a group of English schoolgirls. As a result of their pleading with the girls, the gang retrieve all but one of the towers. But the last one is in the hands of a very determined student, and she refuses to part with it... With Sid James, Alfie Bass and Majorie Fielding. (The Lavender Hill Mob). Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Sol.
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël. (Sol). [16+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: All Our Desires.
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor. (Toutes nos envies). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Unknown Country.
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits. (The Unknown Country). [12+]. Mistika. Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Ramen Shop.
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients. (Ramen Teh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle.
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel. (Casse-tête chinois). Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Enduring Love.
programme.desc: Roger Michell's drama, based on Ian McEwan's novel, of unrequited love stars Daniel Craig as Joe, out with his girlfriend Claire (Samantha Morton) for a picnic in the countryside. Suddenly, over the trees, appears a hot-air balloon that lands, tipping out the pilot, and then rises again, leaving a young boy stranded in the basket. Joe and other bystanders grab the trailing ropes but, one by one, they are forced to let go as the balloon ascends, except for one person who is borne aloft, before falling to his fate. Joe and Jed (Rhys Ifans) find his body. For Claire and Joe, life returns to a semblance of normality, until Joe starts running into Jed - again and again. And as Jed's obsession grows, so does the danger to Joe and Claire. (Enduring Love). Romantiniai. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Sorry Angel.
programme.desc: 1993. Jacques (Pierre Deladonchamps) is a 39-year-old gay author living and working in Paris. He is a part-time, albeit inattentive, father to his young son Loulou, who stays with him every other night. Loulou is accustomed to his father's bouts of self-indulgent melancholy as well as his manic appreciation for the arts and his string of young lovers. At the same time, Jacques is in the process of coming to terms with his health's steady decline due to AIDS, which is simultaneously and severely affecting his ex-lover Marco. When Marco is rejected by his lover Thierry and comes to stay with Jacques, the two discuss again their intentions to commit suicide before they can be claimed by the disease. Jacques lives on the floor below his good friend Mathieu (Denis Podalydès), an older gay man and newspaper editor who regular caters to Jacques' flamboyant episodes. (Plaire, aimer et courir vite). Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: My Heart Can't Beat Unless You Tell It To.
programme.desc: Writer and director Jonathan Cuartas twists the traditional vampire horror trope into a gritty kitchen-sink drama. Two older siblings look after their younger brother, who's a vampire, by killing to source blood for him. Forget capes. Forget beautiful familiars and neck biting. Forget huge castles nestled precariously on cliffs in some godforsaken forest. This is vampirism John Osborne style. Three siblings live together in a claustrophobic suburban house with an interior the colour of a well-used tea pot. In the opening scene, the eldest, Dwight (Patrick Fugit), kills a homeless man and takes him back to the house where he and his sister Jessie (Ingrid Sophie Schram) drain the corpse into a corrugated metal bin with a tap. They then decant the blood into the bowl and take it to their ailing younger brother Thomas (Owen Campbell), who's apparently catatonic in bed. As he drinks the claret, Thomas revives. And so it goes on. Jessie works as a waiter in a diner and lets Dwight know if she spots a potential kill. Dwight is at the end of his tether and doesn't want to do this anymore. But Jessie reminds him that it's for their little brother. Teenage Thomas hears other kids playing outside and naturally wants to join them. But how can they break the cycle without breaking their family? Network Premiere. (My Heart Can'T Beat Unless You Tell It To). Dramos. Siaubo.

programme.title: Iris.
programme.desc: When the young Iris Murdoch meets fellow student John Bayley at Somerville College, Oxford, he is a naive virgin easily flummoxed by her libertine spirit, arch personality, and obvious artistic talent. Decades later, little has changed and the couple keeps house, with John doting on his more famous wife. When Iris begins experiencing forgetfulness and dementia, however, the devoted John struggles with hopelessness and frustration, and becomes her caretaker, as his wife's mind deteriorates from the ravages of Alzheimer's disease. (Iris). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride.
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders). (The Decoy Bride). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Summer We Live.
programme.desc: Year 1998. Isabel, a journalism student, is forced to do her internship in the newspaper of a small Galician coastal town in order to finish her degree. When she arrives, she wants to start investigating as soon as possible, to demonstrate everything she has learned in order to become a real journalist. But the position she is assigned is the last one she expected: the writing and management of the obituaries that reach the newsroom. But this, which might seem boring at first, becomes the door to an investigation that will take her through different parts of the Spanish geography in search of an impossible love story. (El verano que vivimos). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park.
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability. (Mi amiga del parque). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Graduate.
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel. (The Graduate). [16+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring.
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master. (Girl with a Pearl Earring). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee.

programme.title: The Painted Veil.
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Only You.

Both are quite troubled to meet again and begin an affair. While Pierre's family life is soon turned upside down, Shauna struggles with feelings she thought belonged to the past. (Les jeunes amants). [16+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ratcatcher.

But Ryan chose to play with James instead, and runs off while his mother is not looking. Ryan meets James at the canal and during some rough-house play he is drowned, clearly with James bearing much of the blame for not having raised the alarm. James believes his inaction has gone unnoticed. (Ratcatcher). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Upių pabaisos.
programme.desc: Ekstremalus žvejas Džeremis Veidas medžioja gėlųjų vandenų žuvį viliodamas ją žmogaus krauju. Teismo ekspertizės metodais Džeremis žiūrovams atskleidžia, kaip šie upių monstrai yra sukurti žudyti. (River Monsters). [14+]. Nuotykių. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Laukinis kovos laukas.
programme.desc: Upėse ir vandenynuose vykstantys vandens karai keičia konfliktų taisykles; po vandeniu gravitacija bereikšmė. Keisti ir nuostabūs rifų gyviai terorizuoja vieni kitus, kovodami dėl erdvės. (Wild Battleground). [12+]. Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: D. Atenboro kelionės aplink pasaulį.
programme.desc: Seras Davidas Attenborough tyrinėja gyvybės atsiradimą mūsų planetoje nuo pirmųjų gyvybės formų atsiradimo jūros dugne prieš šimtus milijonų metų iki gyvybės, šiandien tarpstančios įvairiausiose pasaulio kampeliuose. Šis serialas - tai 7 metus trukusi kelionė po nuostabiausias planetos vietas ir susitikimai su įdomiausiais gyvūnais. (David Attenborough's Global Adventure). Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.desc: Komanda Pietų Amerikoje atkasa reto šarvuotojo dinozauro kaulus; ar tai gali būti trūkstama ankilozaurų evoliucijos grandis? (Lost Beasts Unearthed). Gyvūnai. Gamtos. Mokslas.

programme.title: Liūtų brolystė.
programme.desc: Šioje serijoje pristatomi liūtai, kurie turi skirtingas asmenybes; kartu stebime, kaip jie medžioja ir tyrinėja naujas teritorijas bei kyla konfliktai, kai motinos grįžta su naujais jaunikliais. (Brotherhood of Lions). [12+]. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Liūtų brolystė.
programme.desc: Alkis verčia jauniklius imtis smurto, todėl šeimos santykiai tampa sudėtingi; liūtai medžiodami pasikliauja judresnėmis liūtėmis ir susiduria su tokiais iššūkiais kaip klimato kaita. (Brotherhood of Lions). [12+]. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Liūtų brolystė.
programme.desc: Oloboras tampa liūtų būrio, kurio pagrindinis maisto šaltinis yra buivolai, lyderiu. Oloborui susidūrus su kliūtimis įrodant savo dominavimą, būryje kyla įtampa. (Brotherhood of Lions). [12+]. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Kimberlis: Australijos Laukiniai Vakarai.
programme.desc: Australija žavi savo gniaužiančiu kvapą kraštovaizdžiu, o drauge ir gyvūnijos rūšių gausa. Drauge su gamtos tyrinėtoju Marku leisimės į nepamirštamą nuotykį. Iš arti stebėsime krokodilų, driežų, vandens vabalų ir sterblinių gyvūnų kasdienybę. Jų kovą už išlikimą ir giminės pratęsimą. Unikali augmenija ir gyvūnija paliks neišdildomą įspūdį. (The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West). Gyvūnai. Gamtos. Laukinė gamta.

programme.desc: Nuo dinozaurų laikų izoliuota Naujosios Zelandijos laukinė gamta buvo palikta likimo valiai, o jos miškuose tyko juros periodo plėšrūnai. (New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands). Gamtos.

programme.title: Naujoji Zelandija.
programme.desc: Tai pasakojimas apie laukines Naujosios Zelandijos vietas ir ištvermingiausius pirmtakus - nuo itin protingų papūgų iki grėsmingų sraigių bei stebuklingų šviečiančių kirminų spiečių. (New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands). Gamtos.

programme.title: Teksaso aligatorių gelbėtojai.
programme.desc: Arlie sukonstruoja išradingą naują prietaisą, padedantį gaudyti aligatorius, tačiau rezultatai dvejopi. Shannon sužavi drovų aligatorių, o Arlie ir Jessica patiria problemų už parko ribų. (Texas Gator Savers). [12+]. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Laukinis kovos laukas.
programme.desc: Tyrinėjame nuožmiausias planetos Alpių kovų arenas. Lūšys medžioja užsnigtuose miškuose, rudosios lapės seka peles po ledu, o snieginiai leopardai rizikuoja žūti persekiodami grobį Himalajuose. (Wild Battleground). Gyvūnai. Laukinė gamta.

programme.title: Didysis barjerinis rifas.
programme.desc: Dokumentiniame filme nuodugniai tyrinėjamas Australijos Didysis Barjerinis rifas - vienas iš didžiausių gamtos stebuklų mūsų planetoje. Išsamiai nagrinėjama koralų rifo struktūra ir jame gyvenanti laukinė flora ir fauna, kurios ir konkuruoja tarpusavyje ir bendradarbiauja. Rifą taip pat veikia daugybė veiksnių, įskaitant mėnulį, saulę ir orą. Tik 7% Australijos Didžiojo Barjerinio rifo sudaro koralai. Likusi dalis sudaryta iš salų, mangrovių pelkių ir smėlio lygumų. Ir jose visose knibždėte knibžda daugybė gyvūnų. Kai kuriuos iš jų galima pamatyti ypatingai retai, kai jie kyla iš bedugnės gelmių pasišildyti šiltesniu paviršiaus vandeniu. (Great Barrier Reef). Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.desc: Dokumentiniame filme nuodugniai tyrinėjamas Australijos Didysis Barjerinis rifas - vienas iš didžiausių gamtos stebuklų mūsų planetoje. Išsamiai nagrinėjama koralų rifo struktūra ir jame gyvenanti laukinė flora ir fauna, kurios ir konkuruoja tarpusavyje ir bendradarbiauja. Rifą taip pat veikia daugybė veiksnių, įskaitant mėnulį, saulę ir orą. Tik 7% Australijos Didžiojo Barjerinio rifo sudaro koralai. Likusi dalis sudaryta iš salų, mangrovių pelkių ir smėlio lygumų. Ir jose visose knibždėte knibžda daugybė gyvūnų. Kai kuriuos iš jų galima pamatyti ypatingai retai, kai jie kyla iš bedugnės gelmių pasišildyti šiltesniu paviršiaus vandeniu. (Great Barrier Reef). Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Hailando veterinaras.
programme.desc: Viljamas gydo ėriuką, kuriam įtariamas kojos lūžis, Tomui tenka gydyti 900 kg sveriantį klaidesdeilą, Gajus padeda kukurūzinei gyvatei Tylai, o Šondis turi užbaigti škotų terjerės Olos dantų gydymą. (The Highland Vet). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Deividas Atenboras. Kiaušinių stebuklas.
programme.desc: Kaip atsiranda kiaušinis, kodėl jis yra tokios formos ir kodėl apskritai reikia jį padėti? Po gabalėlį, nuo sukūrimo iki išsiritimo, Davidas Attenborough atskleidžia šių gamtos stebuklų paslaptis. (Attenborough's Wonders of Eggs). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Pavojingo rifo megarykliai.
programme.desc: Pietų Australijoje sklando gandai apie gelmėse tykančius 18 pėdų ilgio megaryklius. Baltųjų ryklių ekspertė dr. Lauren Meyer ir povandeninių filmų operatorius Colinas Thruppas siekia juos susekti. (Megasharks Of Dangerous Reef). [12+]. Nuotykių. Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Ryklys Frankenšteinas.
programme.desc: Galingasis baltasis ryklys nebėra mitybos grandinės viršuje. Neseniai įvykę žiaurūs orkų išpuoliai karūnavo orką vandenyno karaliumi. Ko reikėtų, kad rykliai imtųsi priešintis? (Frankenshark). [12+]. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Laukinis kovos laukas.

programme.title: Laukinis kovos laukas.
programme.desc: Keliaujame į įvairius žemynus, siekdami atrasti dramatiškiausias išlikimo kovų vietas. Nuo liūčių, medžiojančių zebrus, iki dingų, kovojančių su echidnomis - visur apstu konkurencijos ir pavojų. (Wild Battleground). Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Laukinis kovos laukas.
programme.desc: Atskleidžiame nuožmiausias kovas ten, kur vandenynai susiduria su žeme. Nuo baltųjų ryklių, tykančių ruonių, iki baltųjų lokių, kovojančių su vėpliais: šioje serijoje rodomi neįtikėtini vaizdai. (Wild Battleground). Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Didysis barjerinis rifas.
programme.desc: Dokumentiniame filme nuodugniai tyrinėjamas Australijos Didysis Barjerinis rifas - vienas iš didžiausių gamtos stebuklų mūsų planetoje. Išsamiai nagrinėjama koralų rifo struktūra ir jame gyvenanti laukinė flora ir fauna, kurios ir konkuruoja tarpusavyje ir bendradarbiauja. Rifą taip pat veikia daugybė veiksnių, įskaitant mėnulį, saulę ir orą. Tik 7% Australijos Didžiojo Barjerinio rifo sudaro koralai. Likusi dalis sudaryta iš salų, mangrovių pelkių ir smėlio lygumų. Ir jose visose knibždėte knibžda daugybė gyvūnų. Kai kuriuos iš jų galima pamatyti ypatingai retai, kai jie kyla iš bedugnės gelmių pasišildyti šiltesniu paviršiaus vandeniu. (Great Barrier Reef). Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.desc: Spinozauras yra vienas keisčiausių kada nors gyvenusių dinozaurų; atradimas Ispanijoje galėtų padėti atsekti šio paslaptingo žvėries kilmę. (Lost Beasts Unearthed). Mokslas. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.desc: Tyrėjai Vajomingo dykumose atkasa mozauzauro - siaubą keliančio dinozaurų amžiaus jūrų plėšrūno - kaulus. (Lost Beasts Unearthed). Gamtos. Mokslas. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Snieginiai leopardai su Danu O'Neillu.
programme.desc: Danas O'Neillas vykdo misiją išgelbėti snieginį leopardą. Kirgizijoje gyvena snieginis leopardas, niekada nesutikęs žmonių. O Mongolijoje jis ieško didžiausio kada nors užfiksuoto snieginio leopardo. (Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill). Gamtos. Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Indijos pasidžiavimas.
programme.desc: Gudžarato valstija Indijoje yra paskutinių laisvėje gyvenančių azijinių liūtų namai. Čia pirmą kartą gimdžiusi motina liūtė, norėdama užauginti naują karalių, turi būti išradinga ir apgauti senąjį. (Pride of India). Gyvūnai.
